items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: This zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations and is actively being exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical issue.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these specific issues.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An authorization bypass flaw in Adobe Commerce allows low-privileged authenticated attackers to bypass security features and read select data without user interaction. This vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Critical Security Update for Adobe Commerce (SessionReaper)
items.summary: This update addresses a critical vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take over customer accounts through the Commerce REST API. Adobe released a hotfix (VULN-32437) to remediate this issue.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update, originally published June 10, 2025, and updated August 18, 2026, resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including stored XSS via server-side template injection (CVE-2025-47110) and reflected XSS/one-click account takeover (VULN-31547). Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves important and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution. Adobe is not aware of any in-the-wild exploitation.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: This is an Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output vulnerability (CWE-116) affecting Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, Magento Open Source, and the Adobe I/O Events extension for Commerce. Exploitation results in arbitrary code execution without user interaction.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Incorrect Authorization (CWE-863)
items.summary: Adobe Commerce is affected by an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability that could result in a Security feature bypass. An attacker with high privileges could leverage this vulnerability to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized write access.
